# Now I'll write code to reorganize the files. 
# Current format: "<date>__<file_name>.<extension>"
# Target format: "<file_name>/<date>.<extension>"
import os

base_dir = "~/documents/work/meetings_files/"

for file_path in files:
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    # Split into name and extension
    name, ext = os.path.splitext(filename)
    # Split name by "__" to get date and file_name
    parts = name.split("__", 1)
    if len(parts) == 2:
        date, file_name = parts
        # Create directory for file_name
        dir_path = base_dir + file_name + "/"
        apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=dir_path, access_token=access_token, recursive=True)
        # Move file to new location
        dest_path = dir_path + date + ext
        result = apis.file_system.move_file(source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=dest_path, access_token=access_token)
        print(f"Moved {filename} -> {dest_path}: {result}")
